title: Vertex Accelerator+ for SAP ERP Achieves SAP® Certified Integration with RISE with SAP S/4HANA® Cloud
summary: Vertex Accelerator+ for SAP ERP is now SAP-certified for integration with RISE with SAP S/4HANA® Cloud—streamlining global tax management, boosting compliance, and accelerating digital transformation.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/lxv47hos/production/398dd4b1f8ec8f863ab858e2f887de970b56ef45.pdf)


King of Prussia, PA — May 20, 2025


[Vertex Inc](https://www.vertexinc.com/home-page) . (NASDAQ:VERX) (“Vertex” or the “Company”), a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions, announced today that its Accelerator+ for SAP ERP product has achieved SAP® certification as integrated with RISE with SAP S/4HANA


® Cloud. Accelerator+ helps organizations simplify global tax management, improve compliance and accelerate the transition to SAP S/4HANA


with a unified, scalable solution.


“This certification reinforces our commitment to helping businesses manage tax complexity as they modernize with SAP,” said Jeff Bleacher, Senior Director – Global SAP Solution Center at Vertex. “Accelerator+ equips organizations with the agility and control needed to navigate global tax demands and accelerate transformation with confidence.”


Vertex Accelerator+ for SAP ERP, launched at the beginning of the year, is designed to support tax transformation within SAP environments. It provides the framework to manage indirect tax within SAP systems while supporting global configurations and a wide range of tax types from a single solution, working seamlessly with our core tax engine. With capabilities that streamline tax configuration and align with SAP’s strategic roadmap, Accelerator+ helps organizations reduce complexity, support cloud adoption and prepare for migration to SAP S/4HANA


.


Key capabilities and benefits of[Vertex Accelerator+ for SAP ERP](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-indirect-tax-accelerator-plus-sap-erp) include:


- **Unified Tax Management Interface** : A centralized user experience for managing tax engine configuration, utilities, and reporting within SAP ERP.
- **Global Visualization and Reporting** : Features such as intelligent VAT chain flow visualization and curated reporting tools simplify compliance and reveal tax impacts across transactions and geographies.
- **Support for Scalable Global Growth** : Allows use of a single company code for VAT and U.S. sales tax—empowering businesses to expand across borders with fewer configuration hurdles.
- **Flexible Deployment Options** : Delivers enhanced functionality in support of Vertex O Series or native SAP tax determination.


[The SAP Integration and Certification Center](https://www.sap.com/partners/partner-program/certify-my-solution.html) (SAP ICC) has certified that the integration software for its Vertex Indirect Tax Accelerator+ for SAP integrates with RISE with SAP S/4HANA


Cloud using standard integration technologies.


To learn more about Vertex Accelerator+ for SAP ERP and the Vertex and SAP partnership, visit our[partner page](https://www.vertexinc.com/partners/sap) .

## About Vertex


Vertex, Inc. is a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions. The Company’s mission is to deliver the most trusted tax technology enabling global businesses to transact, comply and grow with confidence. Vertex provides solutions that can be tailored to specific industries for major lines of indirect tax, including sales and consumer use, value added and payroll. Headquartered in North America, and with offices in South America and Europe, Vertex empowers the world’s leading brands to simplify the complexity of continuous compliance.
